scripts.build: npm run build -w @riftbound/shared && npm run build -w @riftbound/game-core && npm run build -w @riftbound/game-ai && npm run build -w @riftbound/server && npm run build -w @riftbound/client && npm run build -w @riftbound/client-cocos
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @riftbound/shared && npm run build -w @riftbound/game-core && npm run build -w @riftbound/game-ai && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @riftbound/server" "npm run dev -w @riftbound/client"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @riftbound/shared && npm run build -w @riftbound/game-core && npm run build -w @riftbound/game-ai && npm run test -w @riftbound/game-core && npm run test -w @riftbound/game-ai && npm run test -w @riftbound/server && npm run test -w @riftbound/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @riftbound/shared && npm run build -w @riftbound/game-core && npm run build -w @riftbound/game-ai && npm run typecheck -w @riftbound/server && npm run typecheck -w @riftbound/client && npm run typecheck -w @riftbound/client-cocos
